tagline: A world with zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion.
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted EBIT is GM's primary financial performance indicator, reflecting the operational profitability of its automotive businesses after accounting for certain non-recurring items. It is essential for assessing the company's ability to generate profits in a competitive and complex regulatory environment.

kpis.name: Adjusted Earnings Before Interest and Taxes
kpis.explanation: Measures the company's operational profitability by excluding certain financial and non-recurring items.
kpis.description: A non-GAAP measure intended to provide a clearer view of GM's underlying operational performance.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational performance and cash generation.

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: The company's final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Represents the total profit available to shareholders after deduction of all charges.
kpis.signal: Reflects the company's overall profitability for its shareholders.

kpis.name: Diluted Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: The portion of the company's earnings allocated to each outstanding share.
kpis.description: Measures the company's profitability on a per-share basis, accounting for potential dilution.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of profitability for individual investors.

kpis.name: U.S. Industry Sales
kpis.explanation: Total volume of vehicle sales in the U.S. market.
kpis.description: Represents the total number of vehicles sold by all manufacturers in the U.S. market.
kpis.signal: Indicates the overall health of the U.S. automotive market.

kpis.name: GMNA Market Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of the North American automotive market held by GM.
kpis.description: Indicates GM's position relative to its competitors in North America.
kpis.signal: Measures GM's competitiveness in its primary market.

kpis.name: China JV Equity Loss
kpis.explanation: Financial result from GM's joint ventures in China.
kpis.description: Represents GM's share of losses incurred by its joint ventures in China.
kpis.signal: Indicates financial challenges faced by GM in the Chinese market.

kpis.name: Tariff Impact on Adjusted EBIT
kpis.explanation: Financial cost of tariffs on GM's operations.
kpis.description: Estimated amount of profit losses due to government-imposed customs duties.
kpis.signal: Highlights the significant impact of trade policies on profitability.

kpis.name: Electric Vehicle Capacity Charges
kpis.explanation: Costs recorded following adjustments to electric vehicle production capacity.
kpis.description: Non-recurring charges related to the reassessment and adjustment of electric vehicle production capacity.
kpis.signal: Indicates a strategic realignment in response to electric vehicle demand.

kpis.name: GM Financial Penetration
kpis.explanation: Percentage of retail sales financed by GM Financial.
kpis.description: Indicates the proportion of GM vehicle sales financed by the company's financial subsidiary.
kpis.signal: Measures the effectiveness of GM Financial in supporting vehicle sales.

kpis.name: GM Financial Prime Loan Percentage
kpis.explanation: Proportion of loans granted to customers with strong creditworthiness.
kpis.description: Measures the share of loans issued to borrowers considered low-risk by GM Financial.
kpis.signal: Indicates the quality of GM Financial's loan portfolio.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in exchange rates, which can impact its operating results. Derivatives used to hedge foreign exchange risk have a notional value of $9.2 billion.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in interest rates, which can impact its financing costs. Interest rate swaps used to manage interest rate risk have a notional value of $16.2 billion.

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in commodity prices, which can impact its production costs. Derivatives used to hedge commodity price risk have a notional value of $0.4 billion.

risks.title: Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to counterparty risks due to its transactions with counterparties, which can impact its operating results. Counterparty exposure limits are established to minimize risks.

risks.title: Warranty and Recall Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to warranty and recall risks due to its products, which can impact its operating results. Warranty and recall provisions amount to $13.6 billion.

ai_positioning.summary: General Motors does not have significant mentions of AI, machine learning, or artificial intelligence in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filings. The information focuses on financial and operational data.
